verdict.stance: Overweight / Deleveraging Oman Incumbent + Zain Cash Engine (Ba1 / BB+)
verdict.summary: Group revenue grew 11.4% to OMR 3.41bn and EBITDA reached OMR 1.16bn in FY25, with H126 net profit surging 73.5% YoY to OMR 292.8m on Zain Group momentum and Omani domestic stability. Sovereign majority ownership (51% OIA) and Omani sovereign rising-star trajectory provide strong spread support.

positives: 51% owned by Oman Investment Authority (OIA); incumbent fixed/mobile telecom operator in Oman.
Strong earnings momentum: FY25 EBITDA OMR 1,155.4m (+10.6%), H126 NPAT +73.5% YoY to OMR 292.8m.
OMR peg to USD provides hard-currency stability on domestic cash flows.
negatives: Consolidated exposure to Zain Group emerging markets (including IAS 29 hyperinflation in Sudan and Iraq FX).
Parent dividend leakage vs holding-company debt service at Oztel level.
Exposure to Oman macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.

background.business_overview: Oman's incumbent integrated telecommunications operator with controlling 21.9% (consolidated) stake in Zain Group.
background.asset_perimeter: Domestic Oman telecoms/subsea cables + consolidated Zain Group operations across Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Jordan, Sudan, Bahrain.

recent_drivers: H126: Group NPAT surged 73.5% YoY to OMR 292.8m after FY25 EBITDA reached OMR 1,155.4m (+10.6%).
2025A: FY25 group revenue OMR 3,413.1m (+11.4% YoY), EBITDA OMR 1,155.4m (+10.6% YoY), group NPAT OMR 371.0m (+87.7% YoY), parent NPAT OMR 88.4m (+63.1% YoY).

recovery_analysis.thesis: Group revenue grew 11.4% to OMR 3.41bn and EBITDA reached OMR 1.16bn in FY25, with H126 net profit surging 73.5% YoY to OMR 292.8m on Zain Group momentum and Omani domestic stability. Sovereign majority ownership (51% OIA) and Omani sovereign rising-star trajectory provide strong spread support. Structural recovery anchored by Oman technology asset perimeter and OTEL Sukuk 5.375% Jan 2031 ($500M, XS2695410832) seniority.
